notes: As of 2026-11-02, 119th Congress. Roster status is taken from the House Clerk member data file (published 2026-10-01) and the Senate senators XML (last updated 2026-10-08); changes after those dates were not checked. No predictions about the 2026-11-03 election.

This section lists 23 Members: 3 Senators, 18 Representatives and 2 Delegates. CRS R48535 (May 21, 2025) counts 24 Members of Asian, South Asian or Pacific Islander ancestry (21 in the House including 3 Delegates; 3 Senators) and APAICS (Nov 2024) says '24 AA & NH/PIs in Congress overall'. Neither names the Members, and no fetched page states the heritage of the third Delegate (Guam), so that person is left out rather than inferred; the list is therefore one short of the published count. Each entry's basis cites the source that names that person.

The current edition of CRS 97-398 (Asian Pacific Americans in the United States Congress) is dated June 12, 2013 (113th Congress); it names heritage for Bera, Chu, Duckworth, Hirono, Meng, Scott and Takano and is cited only for them. CRS has not issued a newer edition that names 119th Congress Members.
CAPAC chair emerita Judy Chu wrote on 2024-12-04 that CAPAC expected 25 AAPI members of Congress in the 119th Congress; CRS and APAICS count 24. No fetched source identifies a 25th person.

Considered and not included: Yassamin Ansari (D-AZ-3), whose official bio says she is the 'first Iranian American Democrat' in Congress, and Stephanie Bice (R-OK-5), whose official pages fetched do not state heritage. Neither is shown to be counted as AA/NHPI by the CRS or APAICS figures above (the CRS and APAICS figures do not name Members). CAPAC Executive Board and Associate members who are allies (for example Ed Case, Dan Goldman, Al Green) are in capacMembers but not in officials.

Two entries have weaker heritage sourcing: Vince Fong (NBC News 2024; no official, CRS, APAICS or CAPAC page naming his heritage was retrieved) and Kimberlyn King-Hinds (Pew text hosted on her official site). Reviewers should confirm these before citing. Guam's Delegate James C. Moylan is not listed because no fetched source states his heritage.
Senate member pages (senate.gov) and congress.gov/bioguide HTML pages block automated fetching, so Senators' heritage rests on CRS 97-398, H. Doc. 108-226 and APAICS, not on their senate.gov bios.

CAPAC leadership as shown on capac.house.gov/members, fetched 2026-11-02: Chair Grace Meng (NY-6); First Vice Chair Mark Takano (CA-39); Second Vice Chair Jill Tokuda (HI-2); Whip Ami Bera (CA-6); Freshman Representative Suhas Subramanyam (VA-10); Chair Emerita Judy Chu (CA-28). This matches CAPAC's 2024-12-04 announcement of 119th Congress leadership. In officials, Whip, Freshman Representative and Chair Emerita are recorded as capac 'Executive Board' with the exact title in capacTitle.

CAPAC stated member count: the capac.house.gov home page still says 83; the most recent CAPAC press release (2026-10-26, welcoming Rep. Christian Menefee, TX-18) says 'composed of 86 Members of Congress'. The members page (undated) names 85 people and does not yet list Menefee; capacMembers has 86 = those 85 + Menefee. Count history from CAPAC releases: 79 (2025-02-07), 83 (2025-05-28), 83 (2025-11-18, Walkinshaw), 84 (2026-02-06, Salinas), 85 (2026-07-09, Stanton and Rivas), 86 (2026-10-26, Menefee).

CAPAC membership as listed: 9 Senators and 77 Representatives, all Democrats; 19 of the 23 listed Members are on it (all but Fong, Young Kim, Radewagen and King-Hinds). 'tier' in capacMembers is the heading used on the members page (Leadership, Executive Board, Senate Associate, House Associate); Associate Members are the caucus's allies.
The CAPAC members page prints Rep. Scott Peters as CA-52 (the same district it gives Juan Vargas); the House Clerk lists Peters in CA-50 and Vargas in CA-52, so CA-50 is recorded.

bioguideIds: all 92 IDs used were checked on a congress.gov or bioguide.congress.gov source in this session. 43 were opened on bioguide.congress.gov and the name matched; 49 matched name, state and district in the congress.gov API member list for the 119th Congress (current members; 250 of 539 records retrieved before the API rate limit). IDs were first read from the House Clerk and Senate XML files.

name follows the congress.gov inverted form where the congress.gov API list was retrieved (for example 'Tokuda, Jill N.'); otherwise it follows the House Clerk or Senate XML list name, so middle initials may differ from congress.gov. The cg URL slug is built from the display name; the bioguideId at the end identifies the member.

Official websites come from the house.gov Representatives directory (non-voting Members listed there) and the Senate XML, fetched 2026-11-02. No personal contact details are recorded. Extra fields not in the base schema: capacTitle, bioVerified, x, unverified (officials); tier, title, note (capacMembers); capacStatedCount.
